schema.description: A documented resolution proposal for a Discrepancy that precedes the lifecycle transition and carries the user approval (SDC visibility concept 2026-06-11). Full text: docs/history/profiles/intelligence/resolution-proposal.md, description.

target.description: What the proposal changes: fix_reality = action on machine/process/data, the specification stays; fix_charter = the specification itself is wrong and is adjusted as a profile change in osf-schemas

proposed_mode.description: Lifecycle closure that the proposal implies for the Discrepancy. fix_charter proposals imply superseded (the episode is overtaken by the rule change, linked via resolved_by_rule_change to the osf-schemas commit)

rationale.description: Rationale for the proposal — for fix_charter typically the recurrence evidence (N episodes without a real action)

proposed_by_kind.description: Producer class: human = steward form, rule = AutoResolveRule, agent = v7 Intelligence discussion (advisory-only)

proposed_by.description: Concrete producer: user id, rule_id or agent id

confidence.description: Optional 0..1 confidence of the producer (especially for agent proposals)

evidence_refs.description: Serialized JSON array of evidence references: discrepancy_ids of the recurrence history, audit_refs, KG node refs, query results

constraint_diff.description: Only target=fix_charter: serialized JSON {profileId, constraintId, before, after} — after=null means delete the rule. Becomes 1:1 the content of the osf-schemas PR

charter_pr_url.description: Only target=fix_charter: URL of the generated osf-schemas PR once opened — the PR IS the approval instance

status.description: proposed -> approved | rejected | withdrawn. For fix_reality, approved triggers the Discrepancy transition with a proposal_id reference; for fix_charter, approved is only set once the osf-schemas PR is merged (PR merge = approval)

decided_by.description: Who approved/rejected. Four-eyes invariant: MUST != proposed_by (enforced by the engine); for fix_charter, the PR merger

decision_note.description: Rationale for the decision (especially for rejected)

audit_ref.description: Hash-chain ref (vault-hashchain) for the proposal event — same Ed25519 chain as the Discrepancy lifecycle events

relationships.description: The Discrepancy this proposal would resolve
Only proposed_by_kind=rule: the AutoResolveRule that produced the proposal
